lines.text: In 1956, America defeated the British Empire... without firing a single bullet.
When Egypt nationalized the Suez Canal, Britain, France, and Israel launched a secret invasion: Operation Musketeer.
They expected American backing. Instead, President Eisenhower was furious. He demanded an immediate unconditional ceasefire.
When London refused, Washington hit their financial jugular: dumping British pounds and blocking emergency IMF loans.
Facing total currency collapse within days, London surrendered. The empire died not by gunfire, but by financial checkmate.
